failure_modes: The landmark_00_soft_mass and landmark_10_soft_mass profiles under C1 do not shift toward higher values than the observed baseline over the same window, so the adopted hypotheses are falsified.
Primary affinity does not improve relative to the incumbent M2, or strain/structural validity degrades, despite the coordinate response.
The observed soft-mass curves are selection-window associations, not measured effects of guidance; the C1 delta_A(t) schedule may not transfer to a real affinity benefit.
Only landmark_00 and landmark_10 features were read; the remaining catalogue curves are unqueried, so the adopted observables may not be representative of the full coordinate response.
rationale: Both adopted hypotheses rest on delivered curves: landmark_00_soft_mass (Eef4385e476674774) and landmark_10_soft_mass (Ee9d172f45c064a2e) are the only landmark_00/landmark_10 features with smooth, positive whole-window profiles, while the displacement components are non-monotone with many sign changes and no accepted polynomial trend, so no stationary coordinate target is available. The registered reward-lane choice C1_robust_to_base keeps dose_factors=1 and teachers fixed, varying only delta_A(t) from 0.5 to 1.0 over the observed score nodes [0.0,0.49] (E0857891f4effbfe1), i.e. earlier robust response to large endpoint residuals then baseline curvature. This is the offered intervention whose temporal shape matches the observed soft-mass rise-then-plateau pattern, and it is testable against the incumbent M2.
